data.thought: The epilogue still fails to produce frame.csv; we need a corrected R epilogue that explicitly writes all required files after checking object existence.

args.instructions: Write an R epilogue that runs after the main script. It should: 1) Verify that objects sc, Xs, pd, decision, cf, and fit exist. 2) If sc exists, write it to '/work/out/frame.csv' using write.csv(sc, file="/work/out/frame.csv", row.names=FALSE). 3) Create a data frame scores containing a column '.row' from sc (or row numbers) and the predicted probabilities pd; if a decision vector exists, include it as 'decision'. Write this to '/work/out/scores.csv' with row.names=FALSE. 4) If cf exists, write cf to '/work/out/coef.csv' (write.csv with row.names=FALSE). If cf does not exist but fit exists, extract coefficients via coef(fit) and write to '/work/out/coef.csv'. 5) If Xs exists, write it to '/work/out/train_rows.csv' (write.csv, row.names=FALSE). 6) Ensure all write.csv calls include row.names=FALSE and preserve column order. End the epilogue with a message indicating successful export.
